tagline.en: HappyOyster — a hosted world-generation API integrated into WorldFoundry as a service route.
tagline.zh: HappyOyster——一个托管的世界生成 API,以服务路由形式接入 WorldFoundry。

en: HappyOyster is a world-generation service accessed through an API rather than local weights. Instead of running a model on your own hardware, you call the service and it returns generated world content.

In WorldFoundry the HappyOyster route is registered so it appears alongside local models. Because it's a hosted product, actually generating requires the service's credentials and endpoint, which you configure at runtime.
zh: HappyOyster 是一个通过 API 访问的世界生成服务,而非本地权重。你不必在自己的硬件上运行模型,而是调用该服务,由它返回生成的世界内容。
在 WorldFoundry 中,HappyOyster 路由已注册,使它与本地模型并列出现。由于它是托管产品,真正生成需要该服务的凭证与访问端点,你需在运行时进行配置。

whenToUse.en: Use HappyOyster when you'd rather call a hosted world-generation service than run a model locally, and you have access to its API.
whenToUse.zh: 当你更愿意调用托管的世界生成服务、而非在本地运行模型,并且你有该 API 的访问权限时,使用 HappyOyster。

notFor.en: It needs your own API credentials and endpoint, and outputs depend on the external service — availability, pricing, and behavior are outside WorldFoundry's control.
notFor.zh: 它需要你自备 API 凭证与访问端点,输出依赖外部服务——可用性、计费与行为都不在 WorldFoundry 的掌控之内。

en: Hosted world-generation API, not local weights
Integrated into WorldFoundry as a service route
Requires your own API credentials and endpoint
zh: 托管的世界生成 API,而非本地权重
以服务路由形式接入 WorldFoundry
需自备 API 凭证与访问端点
